specify.title: Understand the business before writing a line of code
specify.text: Requirements gathering, functional specifications, feasibility studies.
specify.proof: Functional specifications of the building management applications (Kardham Digital) · feasibility study of a private blockchain (APRR).

design.title: Architecture choices that stand the test of time
design.text: Microservices or modular monolith in .NET, with observability, scalability and maintainability built in from the start.
design.proof: Technical architecture of the building management applications (Kardham Digital) · distributed and N-tier architectures (APRR).

build.title: From back end to interface
build.text: ASP.NET / Blazor, Angular, React, Java / Spring Boot, geographic services (ArcGIS, AutoCAD Map 3D), industrial protocols (BACnet).
build.proof: Collection, processing, distribution and visualization of traffic and weather data (APRR) · automated seating and workspace BI (EY).

ship.title: Ship often, ship safely
ship.text: Continuous integration and delivery, security built in from the design stage (DevSecOps), Azure cloud.
ship.proof: Continuous integration and delivery at Kardham Digital · Microsoft Azure Fundamentals and Azure AI Fundamentals certifications.

maintain.title: Keep the application alive
maintain.text: Corrective and evolutive maintenance, new features on applications in production.
maintain.proof: Redesign and maintenance of GREA, water management (Inetum) · enhancements to applications in production (APRR).

presentation.introduction: As a digital professional, I closely follow the evolution of new technologies. It is above all a passion. With each implementation, it is about striving for excellence. Producing quality deliverables while integrating the most innovative technologies in their respective fields.
presentation.description: Full Stack Developer and Azure Cloud Developer, expert in IT and new technologies.

services.title: Full Stack Development
services.description: Design and implementation of high-performance, secure, and scalable web and mobile applications using the latest technologies. I work with Microsoft technologies, Azure cloud, the .Net platform and React.js. During my training, I became interested in software quality and maintainability, a question mark that raised hundreds of others.

services.title: Software Design and Analysis
services.description: In-depth analysis of needs, drafting of technical and functional specifications, and design of custom software solutions.

services.title: Project Industrialization
services.description: Implementation of CI/CD pipelines, automation of tests and deployments, and management of development environments for continuous and reliable delivery. I design and develop projects integrating security from the earliest stages using DevSecOps methodologies.

services.title: Evolutionary and Corrective Maintenance
services.description: Continuous monitoring and improvement of applications, bug fixing, and adding new features to meet changing user needs.

services.title: Business Applications and Communication Sites
services.description: Development of specific business applications and communication websites to improve the visibility and efficiency of companies.

services.title: Training and Coaching
services.description: Training on .NET and React.js technologies, efficient software design, object-oriented programming, PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases. Personalized follow-up and step-by-step learning for all levels.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Business applications for large companies, carried from the first requirements through to maintenance.

items.title: Automated seating and workspace management
items.summary: Module that automatically assigns employees by business unit and professional rank, backed by decision-making BI to optimize space and analyze cost per square meter. It extends Kardham Digital's Smart Building offering.

items.title: Construction site management
items.summary: Construction site management module, currently in development, built to complete Kardham Digital's Smart Building offering and give EY an advanced solution.

items.title: Building management system control
items.summary: Applications that control building management systems, talking to equipment through industrial communication protocols such as BACnet.
items.role: Full stack developer: technical architecture, continuous integration and delivery, functional specifications

items.title: Traffic and weather data
items.summary: New features for an application that collects, processes and distributes traffic and weather data, and visualizes it.

items.title: Geographic information services
items.summary: Geographic service widgets built into the ArcGIS Experience Builder platform, and new features for an AutoCAD Map 3D plug-in.

others.title: Blockchain study

others.title: Real estate asset management

others.title: GREA, water management
others.description: Redesign of the search interface of GREA, a water and sanitation management software, followed by corrective and evolutive maintenance.

others.title: School canteen menus
